No hair, featuring a smooth, glistening aquatic scalp. Large, bulbous neon orange eyes. Apparent age is middle-aged and mature. A bulky, amphibious build with thick limbs and webbed hands with four thick claws. Wears an ornate, gold-plated royal breastplate and a deep teal loincloth. Signature details include a large, fleshy neon orange crest atop the head and a thick, powerful neon orange fish tail with a wide fluke.
BODY COLOR: neon orange
